# magpie-zcode-switch-auth **ZCode (GLM Coding Plan) sign-in and account-import plugin for [magpie](https://github.com/yetone/magpie) / [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai)** ZCode's own browser sign-in with an automatic callback · imports accounts saved by [Z·SWITCH / zcode-switch](https://github.com/Saktawdi/zcode-switch) · multi-account concurrency · usage cards [![CI](https://github.com/Arimayuki03/magpie-zcode-switch-auth/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Arimayuki03/magpie-zcode-switch-auth/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/magpie-zcode-switch-auth)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/magpie-zcode-switch-auth) ![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D20-339933?logo=node.js&logoColor=white) ![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Windows%20%7C%20macOS%20%7C%20Linux-lightgrey) ![Runtime](https://img.shields.io/badge/runtime-Bun%20%7C%20Node-f472b6) [简体中文](README.md) · **English**
--- The provider id is `zcode`, matching the official community plugin [`@magpie-community/opencode-zcode-auth`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@magpie-community/opencode-zcode-auth). This plugin is a superset of it (MIT): sign-in, models and usage behave the same, and what is added is importing zcode-switch accounts. > [!WARNING] > **Do not install it beside the official `zcode` plugin**: both declare the > same provider, and whichever loads last replaces the other. If you only want > plain ZCode without zcode-switch imports, the official plugin is enough. ## Contents - [Features](#features) - [Install](#install) - [Sign-in and import methods](#sign-in-and-import-methods) - [Environments](#environments) - [Environment variables](#environment-variables) - [Import details](#import-details) - [How it works](#how-it-works) - [Security](#security) - [FAQ](#faq) - [Development](#development) - [Acknowledgments](#acknowledgments) - [License](#license) ## Features **ZCode's own sign-in** - Z.ai (`z.ai`) GLM Coding Plan - BigModel (`bigmodel.cn`) GLM Coding Plan - A team's plan (team seat), kept apart from the personal one - `ZCode app's sign-in`: follows the ZCode client signed in on this machine - Pasting a GLM Coding Plan API key - The flow matches the official plugin: once the browser finishes, the callback completes on its own — no code to paste **Importing zcode-switch accounts** - Pick one account from `~/.zcode-switch/accounts/*.json` - Import every saved account at once (stored as multiple accounts under magpie) - Import `.zsb` sealed bundles (PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 100k + AES-256-GCM) or plain `zcode-accounts-bundle` JSON - Understands ZCode's `enc:v1:` encrypted credentials (accounts preserved by zcode-switch from ZCode's local storage) **Claiming gift plans** (the same flow zcode-switch uses) - Auto-detection: the usage card lists every gift plan the account can claim, with its grants - Manual claim: pick "领取赠送套餐" (claim gift plans) in the sign-in menu, pass the Aliyun captcha in the browser (traceless first, slider as the fallback), and it is claimed - Auto-claim: with `ZCODE_AUTO_CLAIM=1` the page claims every detected plan as soon as it opens (off by default) - Refresh: after a successful claim the account's sign-in is re-resolved and saved, and the usage caches are invalidated **Carried over from the official plugin** - Models discovered per account (including the gift plans' `-Trial` models) - Coding Plan usage, Start Plan balance, team-seat usage - Multi-account concurrency and usage cards ## Install ### Option 1: from magpie's plugin marketplace (once listed) In magpie, open **Plugins → Discover**, search for `zcode`, and install this plugin. ### Option 2: by npm package name ```sh magpie plugin add magpie-zcode-switch-auth ``` ### Option 3: from a Git repository ```sh magpie plugin add https://github.com/Arimayuki03/magpie-zcode-switch-auth ``` ### Option 4: from a local folder (development / trying it out) ```sh magpie plugin add ./ # inside this folder magpie plugin add /path/to/magpie-zcode-switch-auth # or a given path ``` The magpie app can also do it through **Plugins → Add → pick this folder**. ### In OpenCode Add the package name or a local path to the `plugin` key of your project or global `opencode.json`: ```json { "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json", "plugin": ["magpie-zcode-switch-auth"] } ``` For local development, replace the package name with a relative path such as `"./magpie-zcode-switch-auth"`. ### Verify ```sh magpie plugin # should print zcode (ZCode, 4 models) magpie plugin --json # the 9 sign-in methods and the models ``` ## Sign-in and import methods Open the ZCode plugin's sign-in menu in the magpie app, or use the CLI: ```sh magpie plugin login zcode # pick a method interactively magpie plugin login zcode 1 # or by number magpie plugin login zcode "zcode-switch: 导入全部已保存账号" ``` | # | Method | What it does | |---|---|---| | 1 | `ZCode: Z.ai GLM Coding Plan` | Sign in to Z.ai in the browser; the callback finishes on its own | | 2 | `ZCode: BigModel (智谱) GLM Coding Plan` | Sign in to BigModel in the browser | | 3 | `ZCode: a team's GLM Coding Plan` | Sign in to a team seat (kept apart from the personal plan) | | 4 | `ZCode app's sign-in` | Follow the ZCode client's current sign-in on this machine | | 5 | `GLM Coding Plan API key` | Paste `.` and pick a site | | 6 | `zcode-switch: 导入一个已保存账号` (import one saved account) | Choose from `~/.zcode-switch/accounts` | | 7 | `zcode-switch: 导入全部已保存账号` (import all saved accounts) | Bulk import (multiple accounts under magpie) | | 8 | `zcode-switch: 导入 .zsb / JSON 备份` (import a .zsb / JSON backup) | Give a file path or paste JSON, then the password | | 9 | `zcode: 领取赠送套餐` (claim gift plans) | Detects claimable plans, passes the captcha in the browser, claims and refreshes the account | > The method labels come from the plugin itself and are partly Chinese; the > numbered selection works the same in English. ### Methods 1–3: browser sign-in 1. The plugin asks `https://zcode.z.ai/api/v1/oauth/cli/init` for a `flow_id` and the authorize-page address; 2. magpie opens the authorize page; sign in to Z.ai / BigModel in the browser; 3. the browser ends up back at `zcode://oauth/callback` (forwarded by the ZCode page); 4. the plugin's `callback()` polls `.../oauth/cli/poll/`; once the status is `ready` it takes the ZCode JWT and the site's access token; 5. the plugin mints or finds the `zcode-api-key` with the access token, or lands on a team seat, or on the Start Plan; 6. the sign-in is saved as a magpie `oauth` entry. ### Method 4: follow the local ZCode Reads the local ZCode client's `~/.zcode/v2/credentials.json` (including `enc:v1:` decryption) and `config.json`, then keeps following ZCode's sign-in, its renewed sessions and its plan switches. For when you would rather not sign in a second time. ### Method 5: paste an API key Create a key (shaped `.`) in the Z.ai / BigModel console, pick the site, and paste it. The key is only written to magpie's local credentials file. ### Methods 6–7: import the zcode-switch library Reads `~/.zcode-switch/accounts/*.json` (or `$ZCODE_SWITCH_HOME/.zcode-switch/accounts/*.json` when `ZCODE_SWITCH_HOME` is set). Method 6 picks one from a dropdown; method 7 imports them all, and under magpie the extra accounts go to their own slots. > The dropdown is built when the plugin loads. If a just-saved account is > missing, restart magpie, or use method 7, which rescans every time. ### Method 8: import a `.zsb` / JSON backup Accepts zcode-switch's sealed export (the `zsw-accounts-bundle` envelope) and also a plain `zcode-accounts-bundle` JSON, a single Account JSON file, or a bare credentials object. At the path prompt, give a file path (`~/` and quoted Windows paths are fine), or **paste the JSON text** directly (anything starting with `{`): ```sh magpie plugin login zcode 8 # at the path prompt give /path/to/accounts.zsb; a .zsb takes its export password, plain JSON an empty one ``` On the CLI the password can come from the environment instead: ```sh ZSW_PASSWORD='your password' magpie plugin login zcode 8 ``` ### Method 9: claim gift plans The same flow as zcode-switch's claiming: detect the gift plans ZCode is holding for the account but has not granted yet, pass the Aliyun captcha, claim them, and refresh the account's state. 1. In the sign-in menu pick "领取赠送套餐" (claim gift plans), then an account (the local ZCode app's sign-in, an account already signed in to magpie / OpenCode, or any zcode-switch account); 2. the plugin serves a temporary page on `127.0.0.1` and opens it in the browser: it lists the claimable plans found by a live scan (name, grants, period); 3. claim each plan, or all of them at once; the captcha passes tracelessly when it can, and only asks for the slider under risk control; 4. the claim request itself goes out from the plugin with the account's own JWT (the captcha ticket travels in the `X-Aliyun-Captcha-Verify-Param` header; the page never touches any token); 5. when the page is done, the plugin re-resolves the account and saves it — the new plan's allowance and models are usable at once. Notes: - **Auto-detection**: no need to open the claim page — the usage card lists the claimable plans, one line each, with their grants. - **Manual detection / refresh**: the page rescans on demand; a successful claim refreshes the account by itself, no re-import needed. - **Auto-claim**: set `ZCODE_AUTO_CLAIM=1` (off by default, like zcode-switch's toggle) and the page claims every detected plan as soon as it opens. - **Common failure codes**: `1002` the event has ended, `1003` already claimed, `1004` not eligible, `1005` today's quota is used up, `3007` captcha check failed (just retry). - **Limits**: the captcha needs a real browser, so fully unattended claiming is not possible; the page binds `127.0.0.1` only, so a claim started inside a Docker container cannot be opened from the host — run claims from the magpie / OpenCode on the host machine. ## Environments ### Windows / macOS (magpie desktop) Add the plugin through any [install](#install) option; nothing else is needed (magpie downloads the Bun runtime when it is first required). ### Linux The magpie desktop app, or the magpie / OpenCode CLIs: ```sh # OpenCode CLI (global npm install) npm i -g opencode-ai # wire the plugin into a project cd /path/to/your-project cat > opencode.json <<'EOF' { "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json", "plugin": ["magpie-zcode-switch-auth"] } EOF opencode auth login # pick ZCode, then a sign-in / import method ``` Headless machines keep the same default locations (`~/.zcode-switch/accounts` and the host's auth store); confirm they exist with `ls`. ### Docker Running the OpenCode CLI in a container with a persistent volume: ```sh docker run -it --rm \ -v zcode-data:/root \ -e ZSW_PASSWORD='your password' \ node:22 bash ``` Inside the container: ```sh npm i -g opencode-ai mkdir -p /work && cd /work cat > opencode.json <<'EOF' { "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json", "plugin": ["magpie-zcode-switch-auth"] } EOF opencode auth login # pick a ZCode sign-in / import method ``` Notes: - `-v zcode-data:/root` keeps `/root` (including `~/.zcode-switch` and OpenCode's auth store) in a named volume, so accounts survive rebuilding the container; a bind-mounted host directory works too. - Put a `.zsb` backup inside the mounted directory and give its in-container path at method 8 (e.g. `/root/accounts.zsb`); pass the password with `-e ZSW_PASSWORD=…` to keep it out of shell history. - A container has no local ZCode client, so method 4 (follow ZCode) is not available; methods 1–3 need a browser for the authorize page, so for fully headless imports prefer methods 5–8. ## Environment variables | Variable | Purpose | |---|---| | `ZCODE_SWITCH_HOME` | Points at the directory holding zcode-switch's data when it is not in the default home (the plugin reads `$ZCODE_SWITCH_HOME/.zcode-switch/accounts`) | | `ZCODE_CREDENTIAL_SECRET` | Overrides the seed ZCode's `enc:v1:` credentials are opened with; points back at the original machine's seed for accounts saved under another machine or username | | `ZSW_PASSWORD` | A fallback source for method 8's password (read when the password prompt is left empty on the CLI) | | `ZCODE_AUTO_CLAIM` | When set to `1`, the claim page claims every detected plan by itself as soon as it opens (off by default) | ## Import details ### Credential priority Credentials are resolved in this order: 1. **The account's coding-plan key from its `config`** (`builtin:zai-coding-plan` / `builtin:bigmodel-coding-plan`, and ZCode 3.15+'s `account:…-individual-coding-plan`) 2. **A coding-plan key minted from the account's OAuth access token** — like the official sign-in, through `zcode-api-key` (created when the default project has none); with no personal plan, a team seat is tried 3. **The Start Plan JWT** — `zcodejwttoken` (or the `config`'s `builtin:*-start-plan`), sent with the account's own `virtual_device_mid` If neither 1 nor 2 works and the JWT has expired, the account is skipped with a reason; it is never imported silently. - **A timeout reading the plan aborts the request and skips the account**, asking you to check the network and retry; it never quietly falls back to the Start Plan. - Other failures (an account that genuinely has no personal plan) still fall back to a usable JWT, marked "temporarily on the Start Plan" in the log/toast. - A user's **personal plan and team seat are saved apart**: the team account shows as ` (team)` with its own uid and slot, and neither overwrites the other. > An import saves a **snapshot**: after switching accounts or renewing in > zcode-switch / ZCode, import again. To always follow the local ZCode's > current sign-in, use method 4 (`ZCode app's sign-in`). ### How multiple accounts are kept in magpie - The account this sign-in returns is kept by magpie itself (usually `zcode` or one `zcode#…` slot). - The rest are saved through `client.auth.set` under `zcode#`; the slot is the first 8 hex digits of the account uid's SHA-256, so **importing again overwrites its own slot** instead of piling up entries. - Several files of one login import once; team seats survive as separate accounts because their uid carries `org/project`. - OpenCode's `auth.set` has no multi-account slot notion, so a bulk import under OpenCode saves one account and asks you to import the rest one by one. ### Device id - An account with `virtual_device_mid` uses it as is (the Start Plan sees the same device zcode-switch does). - Without one, a stable UUID is derived from the account's uid (the same account keeps the same id across imports). - A `.zsb` export carries no `virtual_device_mid`, so imports from a `.zsb` get the stable derived id. ### Encrypted credentials (`enc:v1:`) Accounts zcode-switch preserved from ZCode's local `credentials.json` may hold ZCode's encrypted form: ```text enc:v1:.. ``` The key is derived exactly as ZCode / zcode-switch derive it: ```text SHA-256("zcode-credential-fallback:::") ``` The environment variable `ZCODE_CREDENTIAL_SECRET` overrides it. Unset, the plugin tries the **machine home** (what ZCode actually encrypts with) and then the home `ZCODE_SWITCH_HOME` points at, so a moved library still opens; an account saved under another machine's or user's name will not open, and the plugin says to export a `.zsb` (with a password) on the original machine and import that. ## How it works - The plugin is a provider (id `zcode`) in magpie / OpenCode: `config` declares the model table, `auth.methods` offers the 9 sign-in methods, and `auth.loader` takes over routing and authentication for model requests. - Every outbound request goes through a host whitelist: only `zcode.z.ai`, `api.z.ai`, `bigmodel.cn` and `open.bigmodel.cn` are allowed. - Start Plan requests go out shaped exactly like the ZCode client's (headers and system prompt unchanged); the gift models are exposed to the picker with a `-Trial` suffix. ## Security - **Official hosts only**: `zcode.z.ai`, `api.z.ai`, `bigmodel.cn`, `open.bigmodel.cn`. - Every internal JSON request is checked against the host whitelist; - a saved `base` is corrected back to an official host, so a hand-edited `plugin-auth.json` cannot point an account's key elsewhere. - **No credentials in logs**: import logs carry account display names, counts and failure reasons, never tokens. - **Credentials are only written to magpie's `plugin-auth.json`** (magpie writes it 0600) — never to ZCode's credential store, and zcode-switch's account files are never modified. - **Importing is explicit**: `~/.zcode-switch` or a given file is read only when you choose an import; while loading, the plugin reads only account names/emails for the dropdown, and touches the network for nothing. - **No telemetry**: no third-party analytics, no remote storage. - **Handling credentials**: the account files under `~/.zcode-switch`, `.zsb` bundles and every token are as good as the accounts themselves. Keep them on your machine and enter them only into this plugin's own sign-in prompts; never paste them into any public place (issues, chats, screenshots, file sharing). ## FAQ **After importing, requests go to the Start Plan instead of the Coding Plan?** The account's `config` carried no coding-plan key and minting one from its access token failed (usually an expired access token or a network problem). If it was a **timeout reading the plan**, the import skipped the account and asked you to retry — it never silently degrades; check the network/proxy before importing again. Other failures (an account with no personal plan at all) fall back to the Start Plan and say so in the log; sign the account in again in zcode-switch / ZCode and import again, or simply sign in through one of the official methods. **"The credentials won't open on this machine"?** The account was saved on another machine (ZCode's `enc:v1:` derives its key from the local user's details). Export a `.zsb` (with a password) on the original machine and import that, or set the right `ZCODE_CREDENTIAL_SECRET`. **`.zsb` says "wrong password, or the bundle is damaged"?** Passwords are case-sensitive; also check the file was not truncated. A plain JSON backup takes an empty password. **The account dropdown doesn't show a just-saved account?** The dropdown is built when the plugin loads. Restart magpie, or use "import all saved accounts", which rescans every time. **401 / 403 / Start Plan 405?** The ZCode sign-in has lapsed or the Start Plan has ended. Sign in again the official way, or sign the account in again in zcode-switch and import. **How do I write paths on Windows?** A `.zsb` path can be pasted as `C:\Users\…\accounts.zsb`; quotes and `~/` are both fine. **Claiming fails / the captcha check fails?** `3007` means the captcha ticket expired or was rejected — retry once; `1002`/`1005` mean the event ended or today's quota is used up; `1003` means the plan was already claimed. If the claim page does not open, check that magpie can reach `127.0.0.1` (claims started inside a Docker container must be run on the host instead). **Can I import inside Docker / a container?** Yes, with methods 5–8 (API key or a backup import). Method 4 needs a local ZCode client and is not available in a container; methods 1–3 need a browser for the authorize page, so prefer 5–8 for headless imports. ## Development ```sh npm test # node:test unit tests and sign-in callback tests npm run check # loads the plugin the way magpie / OpenCode do and checks hook shapes ``` Layout: ```text src/index.mjs # plugin entry (the official zcode plugin + zcode-switch imports) src/zswitch.mjs # account library, enc:v1 and .zsb decryption, state src/claim.mjs # gift-plan claiming: preview/claim endpoints, local captcha page src/prompt.mjs # the Start Plan system prompt (as the official plugin has it) test/ # unit tests and sign-in callback tests scripts/check.mjs # plugin shape check ``` Sandbox check (no real account involved): ```sh sb=$(mktemp -d) env HOME="$sb" XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$sb/.config" XDG_CACHE_HOME="$sb/.cache" \ MAGPIE_ADDR=127.0.0.1:3499 magpie plugin add ./ # the next line reuses the same environment: env HOME="$sb" XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$sb/.config" XDG_CACHE_HOME="$sb/.cache" \ MAGPIE_ADDR=127.0.0.1:3499 magpie plugin login zcode 6 ``` ## Acknowledgments - [magpie-community/plugins](https://github.com/magpie-community/plugins) — `@magpie-community/opencode-zcode-auth`, the base of this plugin (MIT) - [Saktawdi/zcode-switch](https://github.com/Saktawdi/zcode-switch) — the account library, ZCode credential preservation and the `.zsb` format (MIT) - [yetone/magpie](https://github.com/yetone/magpie) — the plugin host ## License [MIT](LICENSE)

--- Provider id 是 `zcode`，与官方社区插件 [`@magpie-community/opencode-zcode-auth`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@magpie-community/opencode-zcode-auth) 保持一致；本插件以它为底座（MIT），登录、模型、额度等行为不变，只增加了 zcode-switch 账号导入。 > [!WARNING] > **不要与官方 `zcode` 插件同时安装**：两者声明同一个 provider，后加载的会覆盖先加载的。只想用纯 ZCode、不需要导入 zcode-switch 账号时，直接用官方插件即可。 ## 目录 - [功能特性](#功能特性) - [安装](#安装) - [登录与导入方式](#登录与导入方式) - [部署环境](#部署环境) - BigModel（智谱，`bigmodel.cn`）GLM Coding Plan - 团队席位（team plan），与个人套餐分开保存 - `ZCode app's sign-in`：直接跟随本机 ZCode 客户端的登录 - 粘贴 GLM Coding Plan API key - 登录流程与官方插件一致：浏览器里完成授权后回调自动收尾，无需粘贴 code **导入 zcode-switch JSON 备份` | 填文件路径或直接粘贴 JSON，再填口令 | | 9 | `zcode: 领取赠送套餐` | 自动识别可领套餐，浏览器过验证码后领取并刷新账号 | ### 方式 1–3：浏览器登录 1. 插件向 `https://zcode.z.ai/api/v1/oauth/cli/init` 申请 `flow_id` 和授权页地址； 2. magpie 打开授权页，在浏览器里登录 Z.ai / 智谱； 3. 浏览器最终回到 `zcode://oauth/callback`（由 ZCode 页面转发）； 4. 插件的 `callback()` 轮询 `.../oauth/cli/poll/`，状态变为 `ready` 后拿到 ZCode JWT 和站点 access token； 5. 插件用 access token 换取/创建 `zcode-api-key`，或落到团队席位，或落到 Start Plan； 6. 保存为 magpie 的 `oauth` 登录项。 ### 方式 4：跟随本机 ZCode 读取本机 ZCode 客户端的 `~/.zcode/v2/credentials.json`（含 `enc:v1:` 解密）和 `config.json`，之后持续跟随 ZCode 的登录状态、续期与套餐切换。适合不想再单独登录一次的场景。 ### 方式 5：粘贴 API key 在 Z.ai / BigModel 控制台创建 key（形如 `.`），选择站点后粘贴。key 只保存在本机 magpie 的凭据文件里。 ### 方式 6–7：导入 zcode-switch 账号库 读取 `~/.zcode-switch/accounts/*.json`（设置过 `ZCODE_SWITCH_HOME` 时读取 `$ZCODE_SWITCH_HOME/.zcode-switch/accounts/*.json`）。方式 6 在下拉列表里选一个；方式 7 批量导入全部，magpie 下多余的账号自动存到独立槽位。 > 下拉选项在插件加载时生成。刚保存的账号没出现时，重启 magpie，或改用方式 7（每次都会重新扫描）。 ### 方式 8：导入 `.zsb` / JSON 备份 支持 zcode-switch 的加密导出（外层 `zsw-accounts-bundle`），也接受未加密的 `zcode-accounts-bundle` JSON、单个 Account JSON、裸 credentials 对象。 在路径提示处填文件路径（支持 `~/`、带引号的 Windows 路径），或直接**粘贴 JSON 文本**（以 `{` 开头即可）： ```sh magpie plugin login zcode 8 # 路径提示处填 /path/to/accounts.zsb；口令：.zsb 填导出时的口令，明文 JSON 留空 ``` 命令行下口令也可以放在环境变量里： ```sh ZSW_PASSWORD='你的口令' magpie plugin login zcode 8 ``` ### 方式 9：领取赠送套餐 与 zcode-switch 的「活动领取」同款流程：识别 ZCode 挂在账号上、还没发到你名下的赠送套餐，过阿里云验证码后领取，并刷新账号状态。 1. 在登录菜单选「领取赠送套餐」，再选账号（本机 ZCode 当前的登录、magpie / OpenCode 里已登录的账号，或任一 zcode-switch 账号）； 2. 插件在 `127.0.0.1` 起一个临时页面并在浏览器打开：页面上列出实时扫描到的可领套餐（名称、额度、周期）； 3. 每个套餐单独「领取」或「全部领取」；验证码优先无痕通过，风控时才需要手动完成滑块； 4. 领取请求由插件携带该账号自己的 JWT 发出（验证码回执经 `X-Aliyun-Captcha-Verify-Param` 头传递，页面不接触任何令牌）； 5. 全部完成后插件自动重新解析该账号并保存——新套餐的额度和模型立即可用。 要点： - **自动识别**：不需要进领取页，用量卡片上就会列出可领套餐（每行一个，标注额度）。 - **手动识别 / 刷新**：页面上随时「重新扫描」；领取成功会自动刷新，无需重导。 - **自动领取**：设置环境变量 `ZCODE_AUTO_CLAIM=1`（默认关，与 zcode-switch 一致）后，页面打开即自动逐个领取全部可领套餐。 - **领取失败的常见码**：`1002` 活动已结束、`1003` 已领取过、`1004` 不符合条件、`1005` 今日名额用完、`3007` 验证码校验失败（重试即可）。 - **限制**：验证码需要真实浏览器渲染，所以无法完全无人值守；页面只绑定 `127.0.0.1`，Docker 容器内发起的领取无法从宿主机打开——请在宿主机的 magpie / OpenCode 上执行领取。 ## 部署环境 ### Windows / macOS（magpie 桌面版） 按 [安装](#安装) 任一方式添加插件即可，无需其他依赖（magpie 首次需要时会自行下载 Bun 运行时）。 ### Linux magpie 桌面版或 magpie / OpenCode 的 CLI 都可以： ```sh # OpenCode CLI（npm 全局安装） npm i -g opencode-ai # 项目里接入本插件 cd /path/to/your-project cat > opencode.json <<'EOF' { "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json", "plugin": ["magpie-zcode-switch-auth"] } EOF opencode auth login # 选择 ZCode，再选择登录/导入方式 ``` 无桌面环境时账号库与凭据的默认位置不变（`~/.zcode-switch/accounts`、宿主的 auth 存储文件），用 `ls` 确认路径存在即可。 ### Docker 在容器里跑 OpenCode CLI、挂载持久化目录的例子： ```sh docker run -it --rm \ -v zcode-data:/root \ -e ZSW_PASSWORD='你的口令' \ node:22 bash ``` 容器内： ```sh npm i -g opencode-ai mkdir -p /work && cd /work cat > opencode.json <<'EOF' { "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json", "plugin": ["magpie-zcode-switch-auth"] } EOF opencode auth login # 交互选择 ZCode 的登录/导入方式 ``` 要点： - `-v zcode-data:/root` 把 `/root`（含 `~/.zcode-switch`、OpenCode 的 auth 存储）落在命名卷里，容器重建后账号仍在；也可以换成绑定挂载的宿主目录。 - `.zsb` 备份放进挂载目录后，方式 8 的路径填容器内路径（如 `/root/accounts.zsb`）；口令可用 `-e ZSW_PASSWORD=…` 传入，避免写进 shell 历史。 - 容器内没有本机 ZCode 客户端，方式 4（跟随 ZCode 登录）不可用；浏览器登录（方式 1–3）需要在能打开浏览器的宿主机上完成授权页，容器内交互导入请优先用方式 5–8。 ## 环境变量 | 变量 | 作用 | |---|---| | `ZCODE_SWITCH_HOME` | zcode-switch 数据目录不在默认 home 时，指向其所在目录（插件读取 `$ZCODE_SWITCH_HOME/.zcode-switch/accounts`） | | `ZCODE_CREDENTIAL_SECRET` | 覆盖 ZCode `enc:v1:` 凭据的解密种子；换过机器或用户名的账号用它指回原机器的种子 | | `ZSW_PASSWORD` | 方式 8 的口令备用来源（命令行下口令提示留空时读取） | | `ZCODE_AUTO_CLAIM` | 设为 `1` 时，领取页面打开后自动逐个领取全部可领套餐（默认关） | ## 导入细节 ### 凭据优先级 导入时按以下顺序取可用的凭据： 1. **账号 `config` 里的 coding-plan key** （`builtin:zai-coding-plan` / `builtin:bigmodel-coding-plan`，以及 ZCode 3.15+ 的 `account:…-individual-coding-plan`） 2. **用账号的 OAuth access token 换取/创建 coding-plan key** 与官方登录一样，走 `zcode-api-key`（默认项目里没有时会创建）；没有个人套餐时尝试团队席位 3. **Start Plan JWT** `zcodejwttoken`（或 `config` 里的 `builtin:*-start-plan`），使用该账号自己的 `virtual_device_mid` 作为设备号 如果 1、2 都拿不到，且 JWT 已过期，该账号会被跳过并给出原因，不会静默导入。 - **读取套餐超时会中止请求并跳过该账号**，提示检查网络后重试；不会悄悄降级成 Start Plan。 - 其他解析失败（例如账号确实没有个人套餐）仍会回退到可用的 JWT，并在日志/toast 中标注“暂用 Start Plan”。 - 同一用户的**个人套餐和团队席位会分开保存**：团队账号显示为 `<账号> (team)`，有独立 uid 和槽位，不会互相覆盖。 > 导入保存的是**当时的快照**：之后在 zcode-switch / ZCode 里换了账号或续期，需要重新导入。想一直跟随本机 ZCode 的当前登录，用方式 4（`ZCode app's sign-in`）。 ### 多账号在 magpie 里怎么存 - 本次登录返回的账号由 magpie 自己保存（通常是 `zcode` 或一个 `zcode#…` 槽位）。 - 其余账号由插件调用 `client.auth.set` 存到 `zcode#<稳定槽位>`；槽位由账号 uid 的 SHA-256 前 8 位得到，**重复导入会覆盖同一槽位**，不会越导越多。 - 同一登录的多个文件只会导入一次；团队席位因为 uid 含 `org/project`，会作为独立账号保留。 - OpenCode 的 `auth.set` 没有多账号槽位概念，所以 OpenCode 下批量导入只会保存一个账号，其余会提示逐个导入。 ### 设备号 - 账号有 `virtual_device_mid` 时原样使用（Start Plan 与 zcode-switch 看到的设备一致）。 - 没有时按账号 uid 生成稳定的 UUID（同一账号重复导入保持不变）。 - `.zsb` 导出不包含 `virtual_device_mid`，所以从 `.zsb` 导入会生成上述稳定设备号。 ### 加密凭据（`enc:v1:`） zcode-switch 从 ZCode 本地 `credentials.json` 保全的账号可能是 ZCode 的加密形式： ```text enc:v1:.. ``` 解密密钥规则与 ZCode / zcode-switch 一致： ```text SHA-256("zcode-credential-fallback:::") ``` 可用环境变量 `ZCODE_CREDENTIAL_SECRET` 覆盖。未设置时会依次尝试**机器 home**（ZCode 实际加密用的）和 `ZCODE_SWITCH_HOME` 指向的 home，因此移动账号库后仍能解开；换过机器或用户名的账号会解不开，插件会提示在原机器导出 `.zsb` 再导入。 ## 工作原理 - 插件作为 provider（id `zcode`）挂进 magpie / OpenCode：`config` 声明模型表，`auth.methods` 提供 9 种登录方式，`auth.loader` 接管模型请求的路由与鉴权。 - 每个出站请求都做主机白名单校验，只允许 `zcode.z.ai`、`api.z.ai`、`bigmodel.cn`、`open.bigmodel.cn`。 - Start Plan 请求按 ZCode 客户端的原样发送（头部与系统提示词保持一致），赠额模型以 `-Trial` 后缀暴露给选择器。 ## 安全 - **只访问官方域名**：`zcode.z.ai`、`api.z.ai`、`bigmodel.cn`、`open.bigmodel.cn`。 - 所有内部 JSON 请求经过主机白名单校验； - 保存的 `base` 也会被校正到官方域名，手工改 `plugin-auth.json` 不能把账号密钥指向别处。 - **凭据不落日志**：导入日志只记录账号显示名、数量和失败原因，不打印 token。 - **凭据只存 magpie 的 `plugin-auth.json`**（magpie 以 0600 写入），不写 ZCode 的凭据库，不改 zcode-switch 的账号文件。 - **导入是显式操作**：只有你选择“导入”时才读取 `~/.zcode-switch` 或指定文件；插件加载时只读取账号名/邮箱用于下拉列表，不联网。 - **不发送遥测**：无第三方统计、无远端存储。 - **凭据安全须知**：`~/.zcode-switch` 下的账号文件、`.zsb` 备份和任何 token 都等同于账号本身，只保存在本机、只填进本插件的登录提示框；不要把它们粘贴到任何公开场合（issue、聊天、截图、网盘）。 ## 常见问题 **导入后走的是 Start Plan，不是 Coding Plan？** 账号 `config` 里没有 coding-plan key，且用 access token 换取 key 失败（通常是 access token 过期或网络问题）。如果是**读取套餐超时**，这次导入会跳过该账号并提示重试，不会静默降级；重新导入前请确认网络/代理可用。其他失败（账号确实没有个人套餐）会回退到 Start Plan 并在日志中标注；在 zcode-switch / ZCode 里重新登录该账号后再导入，或直接用官方登录方式重新登录一次。 **提示“凭据在这台机器上解不开”？** 账号是另一台机器保存的（ZCode `enc:v1:` 用本机用户信息派生密钥）。在原来的机器上导出 `.zsb`（带口令）再导入，或设置正确的 `ZCODE_CREDENTIAL_SECRET`。 **`.zsb` 提示“口令错误，或备份文件已损坏”？** 口令区分大小写；也确认文件没有被截断。明文 JSON 备份留空口令即可。 **账号下拉列表里没有刚保存的账号？** 下拉选项在插件加载时生成。重启 magpie，或使用“导入全部已保存账号”（每次都会重新扫描）。 **请求 401 / 403 / Start Plan 405？** ZCode 登录失效或 Start Plan 已结束。重新走官方登录，或在 zcode-switch 里重新登录后再导入。 **Windows 上路径怎么写？** `.zsb` 路径可以直接粘贴 `C:\Users\…\accounts.zsb`，支持带引号和 `~/`。 **领取赠送套餐失败 / 提示验证码校验失败？** `3007` 是验证码回执过期或无效，重试一次即可；`1002/1005` 是活动结束或今日名额用完；`1003` 说明已经领过。领取页面打不开时确认 magpie 能访问 `127.0.0.1`（Docker 容器内发起的领取请在宿主机执行）。 **Docker / 容器里能导入吗？** 可以，用方式 5–8（API key 或备份导入）。方式 4 需要本机装有 ZCode 客户端，容器里不可用；浏览器登录（方式 1–3）的授权页要在宿主机浏览器里完成。 ## 开发 ```sh npm test # node:test 单元测试与登录回调测试 npm run check # 按 magpie / OpenCode 的方式加载插件并检查 hook 形状 ``` 目录： ```text src/index.mjs # 插件入口（官方 zcode 插件 + zcode-switch 导入） src/zswitch.mjs # 账号库读取、enc:v1 解密、.zsb 解密、状态生成 src/claim.mjs # 赠送套餐领取：preview/claim 接口、本地验证码页 src/prompt.mjs # Start Plan 系统提示词（官方插件原样） test/ # 单元测试与登录回调测试 scripts/check.mjs # 插件结构检查 ``` 沙盒验证（不碰真实账号）： ```sh sb=$(mktemp -d) env HOME="$sb" XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$sb/.config" XDG_CACHE_HOME="$sb/.cache" \ MAGPIE_ADDR=127.0.0.1:3499 magpie plugin add ./ # 下一行沿用同一组环境变量： env HOME="$sb" XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$sb/.config" XDG_CACHE_HOME="$sb/.cache" \ MAGPIE_ADDR=127.0.0.1:3499 magpie plugin login zcode 6 ``` ##
